messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR to tighten the Dedicated autoscale cooldown guidance and add a short Python + Terraform example for provisioning. Looking for accuracy check and link targets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4510
github-actions: [bot] CI started for PR #4510 — lint + build + linkcheck
ben: skimmed the diff — overall looks good. small nit: ‘cooldown secs’ -> ‘cooldown_seconds’ in the YAML example (consistency).
shana: agree with ben. Also, can we explain why we recommend 300s vs 600s? Add a sentence about request burst patterns and prefix cache warmup.
tim: also we should call out the tenant-label side-effect when using short cooldowns — tenant isolation may cause churn if many tenants scale at once. maybe add a caution note under "Isolation implications".
ravi: pushed one suggestion to the PR for the label note and the YAML key. I also added a compact Python SDK snippet — can folks sanity-check it?

ravi: ```python
# Dedicated provisioning example (py sdk)
from redwood import DedicatedClient

client = DedicatedClient(project_id='acme-prod')

config = {
  'pool_name': 'dedicated-us-west-1',
  'autoscale': {
    'min_replicas': 2,
    'max_replicas': 20,
    'cooldown_seconds': 300,
    'metric': 'rps'
  }
}

client.provision_capacity(config)
```

ben: snippet looks fine. maybe use client.provision_capacity_async in examples where we expect eventual consistency? small comment.
shana: Terraform example? I think the PR had a short HCL block but the link target for the module was wrong (internal -> public). docs-bot: detected broken link in docs/source/dedicated/autoscale.md: line 42 -> replaced by /docs/modules/dedicated-provisioning.
docs-bot: [auto-edit] updated link target in PR branch to /docs/modules/dedicated-provisioning (verify please).

maria: thanks for the bot fix. Shana — can you paste the corrected HCL here so I can copy to the PR?
shana: sure — here's the simplified Terraform example I used:```hcl
module "dedicated_pool" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules//dedicated"
  pool_name = "dedicated-us-west-1"
  min_replicas = 2
  max_replicas = 20
  cooldown_seconds = 300
}
```

tim: tiny policy question — for SLA wording we suggest "expected median latency" in the doc. legal prefers "p99" or absolute. maybe add a parenthetical explaining policy vs operational SLOs so customers understand tradeoffs.
ben: +1 on parenthetical. also suggest linking to the Console SLA page (internal) and the SRE runbook for failover.
ravi: I ran the markdown through the renderer locally — the fenced snippets render fine. One thing: the YAML example uses tabs in one place (indentation). I'll replace with spaces in a follow-up commit.
shana: lgtm after those tiny fixes. maria can you merge when green?
maria: will wait for one more reviewer but hopeful to merge today — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
ben: I'll do final quick pass in 30m.

maria: merging after ben's pass and CI green. quick changelog note: "docs: clarify autoscale cooldown rationale, add Python/Terraform provisioning snippets, fix link targets".

maria: merged and backfilled release note. If anything breaks, open a quick revert PR and ping #eng-oncall.
